info.name: Commons — Local API
info.description: Complete current Commons API with example JSON payloads. Import the matching environment, select Commons Local, and send Login first. Authentication uses an HttpOnly session cookie automatically managed by Postman, not Bearer tokens. Request URLs default to the Next.js proxy at localhost:3100/api; direct NestJS is localhost:4101. Mutation requests create or change real database records. Use a disposable test environment rather than running the whole collection against the clean submission demo. Create responses capture IDs; archive/restore requests target those new IDs. This collection documents the existing API and does not fix security-review findings.

Send first. Postman stores commons_session from Set-Cookie in its cookie jar. Default Root permits exploring every CRUD folder. Change loginUserId to maya, alex, jordan or another active persona. No Bearer token is returned by the current API.
Authenticated catalog response: { skills: [{ id, name }] }. Use canonical skill names when saving.
Replaces the signed-in person’s skill list. Maximum 12 catalog skills. Use {"skills": []} to clear. No target person ID is accepted.

request.description: Five answers for employees/leads, six for Finance/Root. Each answer includes coverage, arithmetic and source records.

Read-only endpoint. Current implementation returns role-filtered audit history with readable record labels; audit permissions have known findings in the security review. No audit update/delete endpoint exists.
Requires an existing session and DEMO_MODE=true. Rotates the session cookie. Default target is Alex; subsequent requests use Alex’s permissions. Log in as Root again for administration.
Revokes the current session and clears its cookie. Run after you finish.
